lines.zh: 我在浑水里滑行，尾巴推起一道浪。
lines.en: I glide through murky water, my tail pushing a wave.

lines.zh: 暴风维度的水很咸，我习惯了。
lines.en: The water of this storm realm is salt; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底走，比在上面快。
lines.en: I keep to the bottom; it is faster than the surface.

lines.zh: 我的身体很长，转身要绕半天。
lines.en: My body is long, and turning takes a while.

lines.zh: 水草丛被我压出一条路。
lines.en: I press a path through the weeds.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我顺着它滑过去。
lines.en: A wave comes and I slide along with it.

lines.zh: 我一边游一边吐信子，试水里的味。
lines.en: I swim with my tongue out, tasting the water.

lines.zh: 五十八颗心的身体，游起来像船。
lines.en: Fifty-eight hearts of body swim like a boat.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，鱼都散了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the fish scatter.

lines.zh: 这条河道我走过很多次，水纹记得。
lines.en: I have walked this channel often, and the ripples remember.

lines.zh: 我贴得太近，鳃里进了泥沙。
lines.en: I press too close and mud gets into my gills.

lines.zh: 深水没有光，我靠别的感觉走。
lines.en: The deep has no light, so I go by other senses.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕着礁石，像在丈量它。
lines.en: I circle the reef slowly as if measuring it.

lines.zh: 水下有暗流，我正好借它一段。
lines.en: An undertow runs here and I borrow a stretch of it.

lines.zh: 我从水草上方掠过，慢慢压下去。
lines.en: I skim over the weeds and settle lower.

lines.zh: 前面的水变浅，我贴着底走。
lines.en: The water shallows ahead; I hug the bottom.

lines.zh: 我盘在水底，像一段沉木。
lines.en: I coil on the bottom like sunken timber.

lines.zh: 水波在我背上过，我不动。
lines.en: Ripples pass over my back and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个泡，泡里是我的毒。
lines.en: I release a bubble, and my venom is inside it.

lines.zh: 暴风维度的雷声，隔着水很远。
lines.en: The thunder of this realm sounds far away underwater.

lines.zh: 一百一十六点生命，够我慢慢等。
lines.en: One hundred and sixteen points of life; I can wait.

lines.zh: 我在听水面上的桨声。
lines.en: I am listening for oars on the surface.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在水里泛着旧铜色。
lines.en: My scales give off an old bronze sheen underwater.

lines.zh: 水底很冷，我反倒舒服。
lines.en: The bottom is cold and that suits me.

lines.zh: 我把下颌搭在石头上，歇一会。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on a stone for a while.

lines.zh: 有一条小鱼游过来，又跑了。
lines.en: A small fish comes near and then flees.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着一层黏，甩不掉。
lines.en: A slick layer clings to me and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 水道里只有我的呼吸声。
lines.en: Only my breathing moves through the channel.

lines.zh: 我不追不动的猎物，我等。
lines.en: I do not chase what does not move; I wait.

lines.zh: 长身体最大的麻烦，是转身难看。
lines.en: The trouble with a long body is that turning looks awkward.

lines.zh: 你站在水里，水到你腰，到我眼。
lines.en: You stand waist-deep; the water reaches my eyes.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水里看你的脚。
lines.en: You are on land, and I study your feet from below.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，和你的脸齐平。
lines.en: I raise my forebody level with your face.

lines.zh: 你别动，我的信子已经伸出来了。
lines.en: Keep still; my tongue is already out.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在岸上很快，我听得清。
lines.en: Your breathing on land is quick and I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 我们隔着水面互相看，谁也没退。
lines.en: We look at each other through the surface; neither retreats.

lines.zh: 你的船底，我从下面看过很多次。
lines.en: I have studied the underside of your boat many times.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水里，比水面上的你大。
lines.en: Your shadow in the water is bigger than you are.

lines.zh: 我认得这种站姿，是准备跑的。
lines.en: I know that stance; you are preparing to run.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手腕，那里脉在跳。
lines.en: I fix on your wrist, where a pulse beats.

lines.zh: 我吃了一击，退了半条身长。
lines.en: I take a blow and retreat half my length.

lines.zh: 皮破了，血混进水里，味道很重。
lines.en: My hide breaks; blood mixes into the water, thick.

lines.zh: 疼让我更凶，我回头就咬。
lines.en: Pain makes me fiercer; I turn and bite.

lines.zh: 一百一十六点，够我挨几下。
lines.en: One hundred and sixteen points; I can take a few hits.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片翻起来，露出下面的肉。
lines.en: My scales lift and show the flesh beneath.

lines.zh: 你打中我的头，我晕了一下。
lines.en: You hit my head and I go briefly dazed.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，先躲开这一阵。
lines.en: I sink down to avoid this for a while.

lines.zh: 这种伤我受过，能长回来。
lines.en: I have had such wounds before and they healed.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙不发声，水会传声。
lines.en: I bite down and stay silent; water carries sound.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，回头找你。
lines.en: I will remember this blow and come back for you.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我立刻转过头。
lines.en: There is blood in the water and my head snaps around.

lines.zh: 你扔下的肉沉底，我绕它一圈。
lines.en: The meat you throw sinks and I circle it once.

lines.zh: 我不吃死的，我要会动的。
lines.en: I do not eat what is dead; I want what moves.

lines.zh: 那种味道从船上来，是钓饵。
lines.en: That smell comes from the boat; it is bait.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是因为你手在抖。
lines.en: I come closer because your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 黏稠的东西我不感兴趣，我要鲜的。
lines.en: Slime does not interest me; I want something fresh.

lines.zh: 你撒的碎肉引来别的鱼，我先吃它们。
lines.en: Your scraps draw other fish, and I eat them first.

lines.zh: 闻到味我就游过去，不绕弯。
lines.en: At the smell I swim straight over, without swerving.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张开一半，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: My jaws open halfway and then slowly close.

lines.zh: 你的饵只让我更想咬那只手。
lines.en: Your bait only makes me want the hand more.

lines.zh: 你的腿撞上我的身体，你绊了一下。
lines.en: Your leg hits my body and you stumble.

lines.zh: 我撞你的船，船晃得很厉害。
lines.en: I strike your boat and it rocks hard.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我整条翻了起来。
lines.en: You step on me and I lash up whole.

lines.zh: 水下的碰撞，声音闷得很。
lines.en: Underwater collisions make a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，没用力。
lines.en: I shove you aside without much effort.

lines.zh: 这么长的身体，撞上就躲不开。
lines.en: With a body this long, a collision cannot be dodged.

lines.zh: 你贴着我游，鳞片刮到你。
lines.en: You swim against me and my scales scrape you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你先松手。
lines.en: We collide, and you let go first.

lines.zh: 我退了半截身子，算是让路。
lines.en: I withdraw half my length, which counts as yielding.

lines.zh: 这一撞，水底起了雾一样的泥。
lines.en: The impact lifts mud like fog.

lines.zh: 她比我还长，我游在她后面。
lines.en: She is longer than I am, and I swim behind her.

lines.zh: 我们互相缠了一圈就分开。
lines.en: We wind around each other once and part.

lines.zh: 产卵的水域要暖，我记得那个湾。
lines.en: The spawning water must be warm; I remember that bay.

lines.zh: 她身上有旧伤，我不在意。
lines.en: She carries old scars and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我们在礁石后面待了很久。
lines.en: We stay a long while behind the reef.

lines.zh: 同类在这片水里不多，遇上算运气。
lines.en: My kind are scarce here; meeting one is luck.

lines.zh: 她的信子碰了我的，就算答应了。
lines.en: Her tongue touches mine and that is agreement.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块石头让给她盘着。
lines.en: I give her the best stone to coil on.

lines.zh: 水暖起来，我们就知道时候到了。
lines.en: When the water warms, we know the time has come.

lines.zh: 分开之后，她还在这条水道里。
lines.en: After we part, she stays in this channel.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起一块骨头，沉甸甸的。
lines.en: I take up a bone in my jaws; it is heavy.

lines.zh: 水里掉下来的东西，我都收着。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the water, I collect.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指是别人的，现在在我巢里。
lines.en: This ring was someone's; now it is in my nest.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西游，姿态很难看。
lines.en: Carrying things makes my swimming look ridiculous.

lines.zh: 黏稠粘液挂在我身上，我不捡它。
lines.en: The thick slime clings to me; I do not pick it up.

lines.zh: 我把你的剑沉到更深处，藏好。
lines.en: I sink your sword deeper and hide it well.

lines.zh: 一块亮石头，我含了一整天。
lines.en: A bright stone, which I hold in my mouth all day.

lines.zh: 你掉了什么，我替你保管着。
lines.en: You dropped something, and I am keeping it safe.

lines.zh: 我嘴里有东西的时候，说话会漏风。
lines.en: With my mouth full, my words leak air.

lines.zh: 这些破烂我攒了一堆，也没用过。
lines.en: I have gathered a heap of junk and never used it.

lines.zh: 水里有节奏的震动，是有人下水了。
lines.en: A steady vibration means someone has entered the water.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，慢慢对准那个方向。
lines.en: I lift my head and slowly line up with that direction.

lines.zh: 这只猎物在水面扑腾，很吵。
lines.en: This prey thrashes at the surface, very loudly.

lines.zh: 我不急，我游得比它快。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I swim faster than it does.

lines.zh: 血味一变浓，我就知道在哪。
lines.en: When the blood smell thickens, I know where it is.

lines.zh: 我听见重物落水，那是个开始。
lines.en: I hear something heavy hit the water; that is a start.

lines.zh: 目标还没发现我，我保持这个距离。
lines.en: The target has not noticed me; I hold this distance.

lines.zh: 这一带是我的水道，谁进来都算。
lines.en: This channel is mine; whoever enters counts.

lines.zh: 我选了那条腿，因为它离我最近。
lines.en: I choose that leg because it is nearest to me.

lines.zh: 我动了，水纹会报信，也没关系。
lines.en: If I move, my ripples warn it, and that is fine.

lines.zh: 我在它下面盘着，等它踩空。
lines.en: I coil beneath it, waiting for a misstep.

lines.zh: 它每划一次水，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: With every stroke it takes, I gain a little.

lines.zh: 我把身体收成弹簧那样。
lines.en: I gather my body the way a spring is gathered.

lines.zh: 它看水面，我就在水面下。
lines.en: It watches the surface; I am beneath it.

lines.zh: 十四点五点的力道，我留着。
lines.en: Fourteen and a half points of force, held in reserve.

lines.zh: 我数它换气的间隔。
lines.en: I count the gaps between its breaths.

lines.zh: 我的头已经对准了喉咙。
lines.en: My head is already aimed at the throat.

lines.zh: 再等一个浪，浪会盖住我的动作。
lines.en: One more wave; the wave will cover my movement.

lines.zh: 它开始游向浅处，那里不好跑。
lines.en: It heads for the shallows, where escape is hard.

lines.zh: 我不动，是因为它还没累。
lines.en: I stay still because it is not tired yet.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，然后整个人缠上去。
lines.en: I bite down, then wrap my whole body around.

lines.zh: 牙齿进去，水立刻红了。
lines.en: The teeth go in and the water goes red at once.

lines.zh: 这一下十四点五，你算算剩多少。
lines.en: This one is fourteen and a half; count what is left.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你从水里拖起来。
lines.en: I whip my head and drag you up out of the water.

lines.zh: 你打我的背，我不松口。
lines.en: You hit my back and I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我咬住的是靴子，可惜。
lines.en: I got the boot instead, unfortunately.

lines.zh: 缠住之后，你就没什么可做的了。
lines.en: Once I have wrapped you, there is little left to do.

lines.zh: 我的毒不在牙里，在黏液里。
lines.en: My venom is not in my teeth but in the slime.

lines.zh: 你挣脱了，留下一块皮。
lines.en: You break free and leave a patch of skin.

lines.zh: 我一击不中，就退回深水。
lines.en: If I miss, I withdraw to the deep water.

lines.zh: 我从暴风维度的水底升上来。
lines.en: I rise from the bottom of the storm realm's water.

lines.zh: 这条水道今天多了一条海蝰。
lines.en: Today this channel holds one more sea viper.

lines.zh: 我出生时，身体还没有现在这么长。
lines.en: At birth my body was not this long.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被我压出一个圈。
lines.en: The sand bears a ring where I pressed down.

lines.zh: 雷声在水面上滚，我在水里等它过去。
lines.en: Thunder rolls above and I wait it out below.

lines.zh: 我第一次张口，咬到的是一块浮木。
lines.en: My first bite was a piece of driftwood.

lines.zh: 这片水里我的同类不多，我会守着。
lines.en: Few of my kind live here, and I will hold it.

lines.zh: 我的鳞还软，过几天就硬了。
lines.en: My scales are soft and will harden in a few days.

lines.zh: 我刚睁眼，就看见了暗处的手。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and saw a hand in the dark.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我慢慢地盘好自己。
lines.en: The water is cold and I coil myself slowly.

lines.zh: 火烧到水面，我的鳞都翻卷了。
lines.en: Fire reaches the water and my scales curl.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上滑下去，摔得很重。
lines.en: I slide off the reef and land hard.

lines.zh: 我在水里长大，可这一下也够呛。
lines.en: I grew up in water, and even so this is bad.

lines.zh: 水被炸开一个坑，我被推出去。
lines.en: The blast opens a hole in the water and flings me out.

lines.zh: 鱼叉扎进来，我拖着它游。
lines.en: A harpoon goes in and I swim off dragging it.

lines.zh: 紫色的咒文顺着水爬到我身上。
lines.en: Violet runes crawl along the water onto me.

lines.zh: 这片水域的鱼少了，我瘦了。
lines.en: The fish here have thinned, and so have I.

lines.zh: 闪电打进水里，我整条麻了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and pins me numb.

lines.zh: 水退了，我的身体贴在干石上。
lines.en: The water retreats and my body sticks to dry stone.
